title: [Once Upon a Time]
description: Heavy lengths of charcoal grey velvet cover the western windows of the shop, blotting the scant moonlight crawling along the half-working clocks interspersed along the walls.  A fine shimmer of dust veils the hourglass-shaped tables at the center of the room, the flat surfaces littered with parchments and tomes stuffed with scraps of suede.  Copper-piped frames dangle polished pocketwatches along the eastern wall, the long chains swaying in perfect time with each tick.
